blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. The reports count condos and townhomes together in one line, so this table cannot separate the two. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Coquitlam total for condos and townhomes that month.

blocks.text: Listings of condos and townhomes in Coquitlam West fell from 390 in June to 353 in October (−9.5%), and 222 sold across the 5 months. In October the community held 45.3% of Coquitlam’s 779 condos and townhomes listed.
Condos and townhomes or houses in Coquitlam West?

blocks.text: Condo buildings in Coquitlam West
567 Clarke & Como — 567 Clarke Road

A 49-storey, 364-unit concrete strata high-rise built in 2021 by Marcon, steps to Burquitlam SkyTrain Station; current listings describe over 20,000 sq ft of amenities including concierge, fitness centre, sauna, sports courts, guest suites and a 49th-floor Sky Lounge, with full air conditioning. Published rental/pet/age restrictions: confirm on the Form B.
Lougheed Heights — 657 Whiting Way
Strata plan EPS4093; a 37-storey, 597-unit concrete strata high-rise built in 2019 by Bosa Properties.
Marquee at Lougheed Heights — 652 Whiting Way

Strata plan EPS4095; a 29-storey, 242-unit concrete strata high-rise built in 2020 by BlueSky Properties (a current listing credits Bosa as the renowned developer behind the Lougheed Heights project — the developer attribution differs between sources; the strata plan and form are not in dispute). Listings describe 17,000 sq ft of amenities including a fitness centre, outdoor pool, party room and dog walk.
Precidia Lougheed — 699 Whiting Way

A 29-storey, 178-unit concrete strata high-rise built in 2024 by Ledingham McAllister; current listings describe it as rising 29 storeys in the heart of West Coquitlam, steps to SkyTrain, shops and dining, with pets recorded as "Cats OK" on one listing.
The Burquitlam Capital — 691 North Road

Built 2019; a concrete freehold strata tower, strata plan EPS5721 — one building source records 193 homes in 23 storeys, while the developer records 189 condominiums plus four townhomes and approximately 10,500 sq ft of commercial space (the counts differ by source and are both stated here; the strata plan governs). The developer places it 200 metres from Burquitlam Station. Amenities in listings: rooftop garden with BBQ, gym, lounge and EV charging.
Brookside Manor — 515 Whiting Way

Built 1993 (building directory, secondary source). The directory records restrictions as: pets allowed with restrictions, rentals allowed with restrictions, and lists amenities as elevator, garden, in-suite laundry, storage and wheelchair access.
Streets, schools and getting around Coquitlam West

items.t: Main roads serving the area: North Road, Clarke Road, Austin Avenue and Lougheed Highway; Burnaby (Lougheed / Cariboo) sits across North Road to the west and Central Coquitlam to the east.

Where the condo stock concentrates: almost entirely at the two station nodes — the Whiting Way / Clarke Road tower cluster between Burquitlam and Lougheed Town Centre stations (567 Clarke & Como, Lougheed Heights, Marquee, Precidia, Elements at Burquitlam, Brookside Manor) and the North Road tower at Burquitlam Station (The Burquitlam Capital). The Austin Avenue and interior streets remain freehold houses.

At the Coquitlam community level that month, condos & townhomes posted a median sale price of $625,000, $687/sqft, 96% sale-to-list and 23 days on market (SnapStats GVR September 2026 report — community-level figures only; SnapStats publishes no sub-area medians).
Transit anchors: Burquitlam Station (Millennium Line, Evergreen Extension) and Lougheed Town Centre Station (Millennium and Expo Lines).

blocks.text: Local rules that affect condo buyers in Coquitlam West

items.t: Watercourse permit area: a Watercourse Protection Development Permit can be required for land within 30 metres of the top of bank or top of ravine bank of any watercourse in this part of Coquitlam, with Zoning Bylaw s. 519 flood-protection setbacks and s. 523 riparian rules behind it — relevant to strata capital planning in slope-side buildings.

blocks.text: Good to know about Coquitlam West

items.t: Two sources give The Burquitlam Capital two different sizes. A building source records 193 homes in 23 storeys (strata plan EPS5721); the developer records 189 condominiums plus four townhomes — 193 homes in total, counted differently. The strata plan, not either marketing count, governs unit entitlement and fees.

A third station-area district is already in presale. Burquitlam Park District, by Intergulf at Clarke Road and Como Lake Avenue, is planned in two phases: 40- and 33-storey condo towers with 663 strata homes in phase one, a further 213 market condominiums in a 27-storey tower in phase two, plus a rental apartment tower and a 5-storey non-market rental building, with completion estimated for 2028. The rental components are not strata condos and are not counted in.

The City renamed the ground under the towers. The same station areas the MLS calls Coquitlam West are planned by the City as Southwest Coquitlam, and the Transit-Oriented Areas Update plus Southwest Shoulders and Corridors amendments were adopted following a public hearing — planning documents and listing copy using older area names are describing the same stations.
Detached and strata moved in opposite directions in September 2026.

Elements at Burquitlam (628 Whiting Way) is the newest tower, dated 2026 by the building directory, with no units listed for sale at last check. Early resales there are effectively new-build purchases for GST and warranty purposes until the facts of the specific unit say otherwise.

Streets, schools and getting around Coquitlam West

items.t: Coquitlam West is the GVR board sub-area name for the City of Coquitlam's south-west side; the City plans the same area as Southwest Coquitlam — the neighbourhoods around the Burquitlam and Lougheed Town Centre SkyTrain stations and along Austin Avenue.
Roads: North Road, Clarke Road, Austin Avenue and Lougheed Highway. Stations: Burquitlam (Millennium Line, Evergreen Extension) and Lougheed Town Centre (Millennium and Expo Lines).
Coquitlam community "Condos & Townhomes" combined median was $625,000 in September 2026 ($687/sqft, 96% sale-to-list, 23 days on market).
Schools: SD43 catchments are address-based. School names use Ministry-listed names only.

Library and care: Coquitlam Public Library Poirier branch, 575 Poirier Street, is in this part of the city (City Centre branch, 1169 Pinetree Way, serves Coquitlam as a whole); Eagle Ridge Hospital, 475 Guildford Way, Port Moody, is the Fraser Health hospital on the Port Moody / Coquitlam border.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect townhome buyers in Coquitlam West

items.t: Form B diligence (The Gable, the counted strata): Strata Property Act s. 59 — the Form B states the lot's monthly strata fees, amounts owing, approved special levies still payable, the CRF balance and an insurance summary, with the rules, current budget, any Rental Disclosure Statement and the most recent depreciation report attached; provided within 7 days, maximum $35 plus up to 25 cents per page.

Presales (REDMA) — Komo: a presale buyer must receive the developer's disclosure statement (REDMA s. 18) and has a 7-day rescission period from the later of signing or acknowledging it (REDMA s. 21), with deposits in trust.

blocks.text: Good to know about Coquitlam West

items.t: Edgar Avenue holds both ends of the townhouse story on one street: The Gable (688 Edgar Avenue, 2008 strata townhouses) and Allison by Mosaic (708 Edgar Avenue, 2024 apartment building whose garden unit is marketed as "townhome-like") — same builder family, same street, opposite tenure documents. The listing adjective is not the form; the title is.

Detached and strata moved in opposite directions in the same month (September 2026): a 3% sales ratio for houses against 10% for condos & townhomes — a house seller here is pricing into the slower of the city's two markets, whatever the tower cranes suggest.

blocks.text: Coquitlam West home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

389 condos sold in Coquitlam West with a median price of $620,000 (the middle half sold between $509,900 and $728,000), taking a median of 27 days to sell at 97.5% of the last list price; 7% sold above list. They had a median $835 per square foot, a median year built of 2021 and a median strata fee of $393 a month. 46 townhomes sold in Coquitlam West with a median price of $938,950 (the middle half sold between $799,225 and $1,024,975), taking a median of 36 days to sell at 99.0% of the last list price; 7% sold above list. They had a median $749 per square foot, a median year built of 2023 and a median strata fee of $423 a month.

faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 353 condos and townhomes listed in Coquitlam West. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.
faq.q: How many condos and townhomes are for sale in Coquitlam West?

faq.a: In October 2026, condos and townhomes in Coquitlam West had a sales ratio of 12%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.
faq.q: Is Coquitlam West a buyers’ or sellers’ market for condos and townhomes?

faq.a: 222 condos and townhomes sold in Coquitlam West over those 5 months, out of 596 in all of Coquitlam.

faq.a: Both station areas sit inside this one sub-area: The Burquitlam Capital (691 North Road) is at Burquitlam Station, and the Whiting Way / Clarke Road cluster (Lougheed Heights, Marquee, Precidia, Elements, Brookside Manor, 567 Clarke & Como) sits between Burquitlam and Lougheed Town Centre stations — a current Marquee listing describes that position expressly.

faq.a: Almost all of it is 2019 or later concrete: Lougheed Heights and The Burquitlam Capital (2019), Marquee (2020), 567 Clarke & Como (2021), Precidia (2024) and Elements at Burquitlam (2026).
